title: Einride strikes deal to add 500 Tesla Semis to its fleet
summary: Swedish electric and autonomous trucking company Einride said Tuesday it plans to buy 500 Tesla Semis and make the electric big rigs available to Amazon and other customers. Einride is using a third party to finance the purchase of the Tesla Semis.
